scope: slice 8 gamification frontend (implement-gamification-ui): HQ progress panel (rank, XP bar, solved tasks), the rank-up celebration (one-shot, ackRankUp, reduced-motion variant), the mission-complete screen /summary, replay from the briefing and the summary, XP / bonus / rank-up on the task feedback, the skin deny-list check, the extended child contract stub

findings.title: Mission-complete screen can show a "+0 XP" sticker and "Získala jsi 0 XP." for a first run
findings.resolution: SummaryScreen renders the XP sticker and "Získala jsi {xp} XP." only when xpEarned > 0; a first run with 0 shows child.summary.noXpText. Test: SummaryScreen.test.tsx "a first run that earned no XP".

findings.title: Summary replay button ignores 409 and never clears its error, unlike the briefing
findings.resolution: Shared useReplay hook (features/mission/useReplay.ts): alert cleared before each try; 409 refetches the briefing / opens the briefing from the summary. Tests in SummaryScreen.test.tsx.

findings.title: Bonus copy says "za splněnou misi" even when bonusXp covers several missions
findings.resolution: child.task.bonusMany when completedMissionIds holds more than one mission. Test in TaskXp.test.tsx.

findings.title: Mission-complete screen can show "+0 XP" and "Získala jsi 0 XP." on a first (non-replay) run
findings.resolution: Same fix as F01 (duplicate across dimensions).

findings.title: Task 3.7 is unticked although its recordings and vision report exist
findings.resolution: Task 3.7 ticked with its evidence after re-recording and re-running vision-verify (8/8 met and readable).

findings.title: Mid-mission celebration on the task screen is not scanned in light and dark
findings.resolution: e2e/a11y.spec.ts CELEBRATIONS gains "task feedback with a mid-mission rank-up" (axe light + dark, reduced motion).

findings.title: Stub progress data is inconsistent: XP and rank without any solved task
findings.resolution: tools/record-slice8.mjs: HQ clips are prepared by earlier practice (5 solved tasks, 90 XP) plus an outside-session credit, so XP, solved count and mission states agree; clips re-recorded.

findings.title: Vision evidence does not cover every FR the slice 8 manifest claims
findings.resolution: Vision args now carry each clip's manifest FR list and requirement text for every FR; re-judged 8/8 (trace/workflow-runs/20261007-101043-vision-verify.json).

findings.title: Briefing shows 'Můžeš získat až {xp} XP', which no delta requirement covers
findings.resolution: Practice-flow delta gains "XP still to earn on the briefing" with two scenarios.

findings.title: Coverage summary
findings.resolution: The one partial scenario ("Replay earns no XP": 0 hard-coded in the catalog) now formats the server's xpEarned into child.summary.replayText.
